title: Ball Lightning Was Finally Recorded, and It Contains Soil

scenes.text: Ball lightning is real, and scientists found it contains soil.
In July 2012, researchers in China were filming a thunderstorm when lightning struck the ground.
Right after the strike, a glowing ball appeared, about nine hundred meters from their cameras.
It lasted one point six four seconds while a spectrograph recorded its light.
The spectrum showed silicon, iron and calcium, the elements found in ordinary soil.
One theory: lightning vaporizes the ground, and the glowing cloud floats away. A ball of burning dirt.

description:
In 2012, researchers in China recorded the first spectrum of ball lightning and found silicon, iron and calcium, the elements in soil.
The glowing ball lasted 1.64 seconds and appeared about 900 meters from the cameras.
Have you ever seen anything like it?
first_comment: Have you ever seen ball lightning?
